svg.aria-label: Commit City: a Bengaluru that grows with my GitHub contributions, 414 so far since 2023. It has 9 buildings, one for each of my public repos (BITCOIN-500, CPP-LAB-SEM-II, Room_Sensor, landingpage-web, Smoke-Detection-for-Dump-Yard and 4 more). Commit Soudha, the town hall, starts going up at 800 contributions. The Commit Metro train runs through it with my last 53 weeks, one coach per week and one window per day, lit for days I committed, and stops at Commit Street, where $VYK trades at ₹65.75. It's day in Bengaluru.

g.text: Buildings are my repos, buses my merged PRs, planes my DEV posts.
